description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'StreamHandler' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Framework'. It extends a Monolog StreamHandler and overrides the 'write' method to add custom behavior for checking if the log file is writable before writing logs. The class uses a trait for dependency injection and interacts with service container and HTTP kernel services.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A custom log stream handler extending Monolog's StreamHandler, adding a check for writability of the log file before logging.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Overrides the parent 'write' method to log messages only if the log file is writable, based on the HTTP kernel service's status.
